summary: New hire cannot open Feature Flags dashboard — Okta email alias collision after account rename
steps_to_reproduce: 1) New hire (ashley.j@redwood.ai) attempts to sign in to Console -> Feature Flags
2) Okta SSO redirects to /oauth/callback with 200 but console shows 403 RBAC denied
3) Reproduced using incognito and cleared session cookies
4) SSO session shows primary email ashley.jenkins@redwood.ai in Okta profile, but Console lookup uses legacy alias ashley.j@redwood.ai
logs: 2026-03-10T09:17:32Z auth[fnid=84c2]: SSO auth success for okta_user_id=00u8abcd1234\n
2026-03-10T09:17:32Z console[req=0x9f3]: Authorization lookup failed: no RBAC mapping for identity_email=ashley.j@redwood.ai\n
comments: 2026-03-10 09:25 — Aisha Patel: New hire reports 403 when opening Feature Flags. Confirmed with user on a private window. No group assignment visible.
2026-03-10 09:40 — Liam O'Connor: Investigating. Initial hypothesis: Okta attribute mismatch between login and legacy alias used for RBAC sync. Pulling SCIM history.

2026-03-10 10:02 — IAM Team (Jorge Ramirez): Found a recent account rename (ashley.j -> ashley.jenkins) during reorg; SCIM delta indicates alias field removed on 2026-03-09. RBAC sync job uses 'email' field which still references legacy aliases for older users.

2026-03-11 08:12 — Liam O'Connor: Applied temporary workaround — created a secondary email_alias attribute in our auth DB mapping for okta_user_id=00u8abcd1234 to match ashley.j@redwood.ai. User confirmed access restored at 08:20.

2026-03-12 14:55 — Liam O'Connor: Root cause fix deployed: RBAC sync now reconciles both profile.email and profile.login and falls back to 'alternateEmails' SCIM attribute. Added audit alert when alias field is removed for active accounts.
2026-03-12 15:02 — Aisha Patel: Confirmed with user that Feature Flags and Console access look normal. Closing ticket.\n
investigation_notes: SCIM sync historically mapped RBAC identities solely from profile.email. During a wave of account renames, a number of users had legacy aliases removed; Feature Flags RBAC checks still referenced those legacy emails. Reproduced locally by removing email_alias from our user cache and seeing 403 on resource endpoints. Correlated with Okta System Log event id: 0oarZx0KqzQkD7X3Y0g3 indicating profile update on 2026-03-09.
resolution_notes: Temporary workaround: added alias entry for affected Okta user in auth DB and re-ran RBAC sync. Permanent fix: updated RBAC sync job (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/commit/7f3a9f2) to check profile.login, profile.email, and SCIM alternateEmails, and emit an alert if a removal of alias affects an active account. Deployed to prod-us-west on 2026-03-12 14:30 with a canary. Follow-up: run a one-off audit to identify other users with removed aliases and notify IAM for reconciliation.
notes_for_followup: Schedule a weekly audit for 30 days to catch alias removals; consider adding a migration job that maps legacy aliases to login on account rename. Notify HR/IT when mass reorgations are planned to avoid auth mismatches.
